steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Into the Wilds
steps.body:
Your party is heading into the dungeon. Each floor has several rooms — some are combat encounters, others are events where you'll face choices.

At camp between rooms, you'll pick your path: one option is always a fight, the other might be an event or an elite encounter with better rewards.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Loot and Risk
steps.body:
Everything you collect during a run is provisional until you extract. If you flee or your party is wiped out, that loot is gone.

After clearing the last room on a floor, the Extract option appears at camp — use it to bank your rewards safely back to town. Don't get greedy — a dead party carries nothing home.
